nodes.name: VQVAE_last_train_config07s.json
nodes.summary: Training config for the last-layer VQ-VAE on OpenWebText: quantizes 512-d final hidden states of the 8-layer GPT checkpoint with a 64-entry codebook, 6-layer encoder/decoder, entropy and cosine-push losses, 10k iterations with W&B logging.

nodes.name: layer_and_block_config_256.json
nodes.summary: Training config for the layer-and-block VQ-VAE on OpenWebText (T=256, delta_b=16): a two-stage layer-wise/aggregate transformer VQ-VAE with a 1024-entry codebook over the 8-layer GPT's hidden states, plus optimizer, logging and W&B settings.

nodes.name: mi_calc_v6_config 2.json
nodes.summary: Mutual-information calculation config for the OpenWebText experiment: points to the trained block and last-layer VQ-VAE checkpoints and the GPT checkpoint, and sets prompt length 240, 16 generated tokens, 100k samples and the MI results output path.
